_comment: Layout for simple family-recipe cards (e.g. Challah, Tahini Cookies) -- a centered title, an 'INGREDIENTS:' subtitle + list (NAME : qty, one per line), then wrapped method paragraphs. Title is set in the brand display font (SHABOUR-SemiBold, rasterized -- it has PostScript outlines reportlab can't embed as live text), matching every other template's title treatment. The 'INGREDIENTS:' subtitle and all body copy (ingredient lines, method) use a plain readable Avenir weight instead, for print legibility. Printed two-up (2 identical cards side by side) on one landscape sheet for cutting, same physical layout as the tasting menu cards.
